prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: fictional creative-agency portfolio concept, landscape 1536x1024 PNG.
Primary request: Create a professional integrated botanical beverage identity and campaign for the fictional brand RAÍZ. A sophisticated art-directed composition with two beautifully designed beverage cans in the foreground and a large matching physical campaign poster behind them, all forming one cohesive design system. The left can uses cream with dark forest green typography and a spare illustrated botanical stem; the right can uses warm clay orange with cream typography. Background poster has oversized expressive RAÍZ lettering and restrained botanical line art in forest green and cream. Flat printed identity, tactile matte paper and aluminum surfaces, believable soft studio daylight and shadows. Cropped editorial still life that reads instantly as accomplished branding work in a creative agency portfolio.
Palette: clay orange, deep forest green, warm cream only.
Composition/framing: fill the landscape with a deliberate graphic arrangement; packaging is large and legible, poster supplies scale and depth, avoid scattered moodboard tiles. Elegant purposeful typography, strong spatial rhythm, no generic stock aesthetic.
Text (verbatim): "RAÍZ", "BEBIDA BOTÁNICA", "JENGIBRE + LIMÓN". Repeat only these short phrases where sensible. RAÍZ is fictional, not a recreation of an existing brand.
Constraints: no real brand marks, no health claims, no badges, no awards, no testimonials, no fake customers or results, no agency website chrome. Produce a finished high-fidelity conceptual artwork, not an actual client project.
